key_insight: Generalized Feynman-Kac correctors enable sampling from arbitrary target functions of multiple pretrained diffusion models, correcting errors from naive score combinations without retraining.
engineering_relevance: The framework lets practitioners compose existing diffusion models and steer generation toward downstream rewards without fine-tuning.
method: Derive a Feynman-Kac PDE and closed-form potential for geometric interpolation from an initial function to the desired target.
Generalize the log-probability ODE to track each model’s density along trajectories driven by a different velocity field.
Apply corrections during generation entirely in the log domain, with reward-based steering incorporated into the target.
evidence_signal: Tests on analytic Gaussian models closely match ground-truth targets, while MNIST experiments demonstrate non-trivial model combinations and effective steering.
watch_item: Validation in the abstract is limited to Gaussian models and MNIST; scalability and density-tracking overhead for larger diffusion models remain unestablished.
paper_title: Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors
